input_boundary: local ignored audit sheet plus local ignored response TSV
output_boundary: aggregate-only apply status; no private row keys or transcript text
reference_transcript_policy: Reference transcripts are already human-reviewed ground truth for WER/CER scoring; this packet does not ask for duplicate transcript review unless future review fields or content differ from the accepted ground-truth transcript fields.
remaining_review_scope: The packet asks reviewers to complete risk atoms, decision-change labels, expected safe action, confidence, and per-model assessment fields.

review_timing.timing_scope: per selected audio row; values come from local response TSV timing columns

next_action: Fill all required row and model fields in the response TSV, rerun dry-run with --require-complete and --require-timing, then apply with --write once status is response_complete.
